hardening.minimized_reason: A compatibility build option for Werewolf's glibc; no feature minimization is claimed.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Enable CONFIG_FEATURE_PREFER_APPLETS in busybox, busybox-full and busybox-static, keeping BUSYBOX_EXEC_PATH /usr/bin/busybox.
changes.why: Werewolf's glibc refuses a bare-name execvp rather than search PATH, so env, timeout, nohup, nice, xargs, setsid, time, flock and chroot could run no command by name; an applet named bare now runs through busybox's absolute path.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi enables FEATURE_PREFER_APPLETS, or Werewolf's glibc searches PATH again; review before retiring this overlay.
